doc.summary: Self-contained HTML browser for the deterministic API reference.
doc.description:
One file, zero external requests: the reference is embedded as JSON
(angle brackets escaped) and rendered client-side with a module tree,
instant search over names, qualnames and summaries, module pages with
signatures, parameter tables, returns, raises, examples, admonitions,
inheritance and call links, a class hierarchy, a general index, a
coverage report, hash deep links, and a dark / light theme that shares
the readmenator theme key.

name: render_api_site
signature: def render_api_site(reference: ApiReference, project_name: str, config: Config, flow_graphs: Optional[List[FlowGraph]] = None) -> str

doc.summary: Render the standalone HTML API browser.

params.name: flow_graphs
params.description: Laid-out architecture and execution-flow diagrams, drawn as interactive SVG in the Flows tab (no network).
